title: Latvia's Double Squeeze: Border Hardening and Defense Costs Test a Small… · 22 Aug
keywords: Latvia, border security, Operation VILKATIS, Belarus, Russia, hybrid threats, defense spending, NATO, airBaltic, fiscal policy, EU solidarity, inflation, Eurostat, migration, frontline states, Baltic region
notes: Latvia is simultaneously tightening its eastern frontier against hybrid pressure from Belarus and Russia and pouring an exceptional share of national income into defense, while also preparing a financial rescue for its flagship airline. The twin pressures are reshaping budget priorities and raising a question that resonates well beyond Riga: how much security can a frontline EU state absorb before it begins crowding out everything else? With inflation still above the eurozone average and fiscal room narrowing, the burden is landing squarely on households and public services.
